title: PCSO brings free medical-dental mission in Brgy. Masambong, Quezon City

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) conducted free medical and dental services for residents of Barangay Masambong, Quezon City, on October 20, 2026, as part of its continuing efforts to make essential healthcare services more accessible to communities. The medical mission was conducted by the PCSO Medical Services Department (MSD), under the leadership of Dr. Rouel Aparato. A total of 128 patients benefited from free medical consultations, medicines, dental checkups, and tooth extractions. Of these, 38 patients also underwent electrocardiogram (ECG) examinations. PCSO also distributed hygiene kits to residents to encourage proper hygiene and help promote their overall health and well-being. […]...
